integrity: The theorem is established by an explicit analytic section computation and a curvature cap expansion. Finite verifiers supplement but do not establish the infinite assertion; no independent evaluation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The contact and sharp regularity require a centrally symmetric C-infinity positively curved base and a nondegenerate product prism. The result is not asserted for general polytopes, non-product sets, or vanishing Gauss curvature; historical overlap with generic Radon-transform singularity theory remains a risk.
title: Polar axial facets and sharp contact regularity of intersection bodies of smooth prisms
